title: CCD2 Readiness Scorer
description: Score organisation readiness for CCD2 (Directive (EU) 2023/2225) compliance across five domains: scope & product, creditworthiness (Art. 18), SECCI disclosure (Annex II), consumer rights, and governance. Applies 20 Nov 2026. Final stage in the CCD2 Consumer Credit workflow.
